search_advanced.description: OVERRIDES of imported search cases whose expectations encoded the wrong behaviour.

variants.name: "Analyzed sequencing data" must find analysis samples
variants._why: The base asserted entity_sampletype_codes contains D.SEQ. The system did exactly that — searched sampletype D.SEQ with keyword 'analyzed' — and returned ZERO records, then suggested trying A.SEQ itself. The corpus was enforcing the wrong mapping: analysed sequencing output lives in A.* analysis sample types (A.GEX, A.ALN, A.VCF, A.CNV, A.SCXP, A.CHRM).

turns.label: main
turns.query: Show me analyzed sequencing data

variants.name: NHP samples from study GBM must not silently answer zero
variants._why: Observed: cypher matched Study.title only and returned 0. 'GBM' is a Study node holding a single sample, while the samples the user means are reachable via Investigation or sample metadata. Either a non-empty result or a CC escalation is acceptable; a bare '0 samples' is not.
